judgment_calls: Each section heading with authority=guideline is its own heading-metadata node, and each rule node needs only its own section's heading node; the four sections are kept separate rather than merged into one document-wide guideline authority.
Each worked example is one node spanning the whole example block, including the XML code fence, rather than decomposing the dialog inside it.
The two clauses in L4367 are split into separate nodes because they are independently checkable claims (conversational/helpful vs. emotive/duration), preserving the 'should' modal in both.

L4458 is one node despite containing both a permission ('may have a long list') and a guidance ('should provide a short overview'), because the permission is a premise for the guidance and they are not independently checkable claims about the same situation.
L4364 is a blank line and is listed in uncovered; all other non-blank lines are covered by nodes.
